/.title: Tiny Captain | A Pirate Adventure on the High Seas
/.description: Command a tiny ship in a vast, cursed ocean. Sail, fight, and loot your way across the seas in Tiny Captain, a pirate adventure by Mitchell Ferreira. Wishlist now on Steam.

/story.title: The Story | Tiny Captain
/story.description: Some legends are best left buried. Uncover the lost treasure of Captain Marrow and the ancient curse rising from the Sunken Graveyard.

/gameplay.title: The Gameplay | Tiny Captain
/gameplay.description: Voyages, campaign missions, exploration, perks, and ship-to-ship combat. See what life as a Tiny Captain looks like.
